mapper.insert: insert into a2a_result_quarantine(tenant_id,quarantine_id,attempt_id,a2a_request_id,child_task_id,classification,reason_code,reason,payload_hash,callback_inbox_id,assignment_id,execution_attempt_id,status,resolved_by,resolution_reason,quarantined_at,resolved_at) values(#{quarantine.tenantId},#{quarantine.quarantineId},#{quarantine.attemptId},#{quarantine.requestId},#{quarantine.childTaskId},#{quarantine.classification},#{quarantine.reasonCode},#{quarantine.reason},#{quarantine.payloadHash},#{quarantine.callbackInboxId},#{quarantine.assignmentId},#{quarantine.executionAttemptId},#{quarantine.status},#{quarantine.resolvedBy},#{quarantine.resolutionReason},#{quarantine.quarantinedAt},#{quarantine.resolvedAt}) on conflict(tenant_id,attempt_id) do update set status=excluded.status,resolved_by=excluded.resolved_by,resolution_reason=excluded.resolution_reason,resolved_at=excluded.resolved_at
mapper.select: select * from a2a_result_quarantine where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and quarantine_id=#{quarantineId}
select * from a2a_result_quarantine where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and attempt_id=#{attemptId}
select * from a2a_result_quarantine where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and status='OPEN' order by quarantined_at desc limit #{limit}
select * from a2a_result_quarantine where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and a2a_request_id=#{requestId} order by quarantined_at desc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update a2a_result_quarantine set status=#{targetStatus},resolved_by=#{resolvedBy},resolution_reason=#{resolutionReason},resolved_at=#{resolvedAt} where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and quarantine_id=#{quarantineId} and status=#{expectedStatus}
